notes: English and Indonesian source pairs were checked for matching files and structure. The Indonesian text remains unpublished until the translation team completes its editorial review.
The Baby Jesus source incorrectly lists Luke 19:1–10 in the parent book; corrected against parent PDF page 89 and teacher PDF page 22 to Luke 2:1–20.
The English source year is 2025; 2026 dates in this edition define the local reading cycle and do not imply a new source edition.
English song titles are preserved, Indonesian titles are presented as subtitles, and playable audio links point to the official provider.
Parent Time Series 1 Q1 was compared with the English PDF by session/page range and source hash; the reference PDF is not copied into this Indonesian content repository.
Source credits and publication metadata are retained in audit/edition metadata and are not inserted as reader-facing lesson paragraphs.
